newsitem.title: USA: Pyrocap secures financing, changes board.
newsitem.headline: Pyrocap secures financing, changes board.

text.p: Pyrocap International Corp Monday that it has signed a letter of intent with First Capital Investment Corp, which provides for $500,000 in immediate bridge financing, the reduction in size of the Pyrocap board to seven, and the appointment of three new directors by First Capital.
The company said that the convertible bridge loan is part of a larger financing plan which, if completed, would provide about $3,000,000 of new capital before 1998.
The money, said Pyrocap, will be used in part to prepare its fiscal year 1996 10-KSB and subsequent financial reports, test products at Underwriters Laboratories, and market new products.

The company said that the new directors chosen by First Capital will be William Ferguson, named chairman, A. Frans Heideman and G.W. Norman Wareham. Theodore Adams will remain chief executive officer and a board member.
Pyrocap manufactures specialty products related to fire suppression and odor control.
